findings.title: Attack 16, sibling of P3-RT-08-01: M7 says its geometry facts were 'verified by computation on every board of rank two to eight'; the check covered only the finite types
findings.claim: M7 extends the check of SPEC 2.14 to every board of rank 2 to 8. That includes affine and indefinite boards, where neither statement can hold.
findings.expected: SPEC 0.3 [V]: 'the range of boards checked is stated with the claim or is "every type of rank at most 8"'. SPEC 2.14: '[V for every type of rank 2 to 8; oracle function euclidean_basis]' and, for the Coxeter plane, '[V for every type of rank 2 to 8]'. The site should say 'every board of finite type of rank two to eight'.
findings.observed: Beat 6: 'No root lands on the centre, and the roots lie on circles each holding a multiple of h of them, verified by computation on every board of rank two to eight.' Seen box: 'The coordinates y=Ep with E^TE=B make the form the dot product: verified by computation, every board of rank two to eight.' and '... its circles hold multiples of h roots, none at the centre: verified by computation, every board of rank two to eight.' A counterexample of rank 2: on the board with three roads each way (golden layer_growth_examples), det C = 4 - 9 < 0. So B = DC has a negative eigenvalue, no real E with E^TE = B exists, and there is no Coxeter number.
findings.reproduction: npm ci && npx vitest run site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-08-p4-rank-range.test.ts (fails on the source test, listing lines 114, 156, 159)
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 0.3 [V] row; 2.14 'Euclidean coordinates' and 'The Coxeter plane' [V for every type of rank 2 to 8]; 8.4 'Verified by computation for all boards of rank at most 8' (the range stated); lens attack 16
findings.proposedFix: Write 'verified by computation on every board of finite type of rank two to eight' in the three places.
